items.name: MeteredStorageHandler
items.summary: Decorator over an engine-provided `Arc<dyn StorageHandler>` that emits the kernel's standard `"storage"` spans on operations that produce metrics. `put`, `head`, and `delete` are pass-through and emit nothing.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Wrap `inner`. Debug-asserts that `inner` is not already a [`MeteredStorageHandler`] so spans are emitted exactly once.
